answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the echo of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. A dawn of per-task receipts records who did what, and the nectar of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
